_provenance.note: Initialized for MD Anderson EDS migration POC. Hands-off replica + uplift run.

direction.phrase: POC: migrate mdanderson.org to EDS — replica (same-design) + uplift shine variants on homepage

decisions.assetSourceRoot: stardust/prototypes/assets/ (replica prototypes carry the localized media; stardust/current/assets holds fonts + screenshots only)
decisions.externalOriginLinksPolicy: same-origin links to non-inventory pages keep absolute live URLs; NOT flagged data-broken-link (source site is live; bounce beats 404)
decisions.remoteMediaPolicy: live mdanderson.org image renditions kept as absolute source URLs (resolve at view time); local media bundled relative
decisions.logo: header/footer logos are live-origin webp renditions (no local logo captured); kept absolute, recorded as media-reuse-source-cdn
decisions.favicon: no favicon captured during extract; variants not generated (prepare-migration never ran) — soft-logged, pages render without them
decisions.fonts: Minion/Univers licensed kits bundled under assets/fonts/ with licensing banner preserved in assets/mda-fonts.css (local gate instrumentation; delivery must license or substitute)
